title: Quentin Miller  Sounds Off-On Ghostwriting For Nas And Goes In On Fan Regarding Drake & Meek Mill Beef [Watch]
htmlContent:
Rapper Quentin Miller seems to be at his wits' end in the music industry, and it is all over his collaborations with the likes of Nas, Big Sean, Ty Dolla $ign, and the most infamous, Drake!

In a flaming diatribe from IG Live on Tuesday, QM almost blew up a joint in reaction to criticism about the Nas collaboration to have obtained credit on his album "King's Disease II" without being part of it.

Miller told Hit-Boy invited him to the studio while he and Nas finished the project, where he bounced some ideas for the song "The Pressure." In October, QM was a guest on Rory & MAL's podcast where he presented his industry credit.

These are the Miller raps centered between Drake and Meek Mill's famous beef in 2015, and Miller believes that his association still plays a role in his stigma through the music industry that he threatened to leave altogether.

He finished the diatribe regardless if he ever gets a high-level collaboration and denounced the title of ghostwriter once and for all.

Drake and 21 Savage have recently admitted to writing verses for their album "Her Loss" with very few critics.

That explains the colossal shoulder chip!!!
